C1.worst_defect: The hero gives four equal-weight buttons, "Live demo", "Quick start", "Try with your store" and "GitHub". Nothing tells a non-developer owner how "Try with your store" differs from "Quick start", or which one to press first.
C1.where: home.desktop.01 and home.phone.01, hero button row

C2.worst_defect: Refunds at the till and the Customer note work in the live demo, but the page says they need "the plugin release after 0.3.0, which is not out yet" and gives no date. The newest changelog entry is still 0.3.0 (2026-10-06), so an owner can't tell when the demo will match what they can install.
C2.where: at-the-till.desktop.02 "Refund a sale"; changelog.desktop.01 newest entry 0.3.0

C3.worst_defect: The cashier role has to be fixed by hand: "The till's order list needs ReadOrder, which that role gains only in the plugin release after 0.3.0; until then, add it to the role yourself". The quick start is mostly Vendure config (tax strategy, migrations, CORS), which the owner has to hand to their freelancer.

C4.worst_defect: Troubleshooting's till-updates line says "Ask the store owner to look at the sync log in this till's Settings." The reader is the store owner. The page doesn't define "till updates" or say what to look for in the sync log or how to fix it. Refused orders are also called both "Send again" and "Retry".
C4.where: troubleshooting.desktop.01, "N till updates need attention" line

C5.worst_defect: On desktop docs pages the grey sidebar panel ends at about 900px and a lighter background shows below it, so the page looks cut in two. The payment screenshot on At the till is too small to read.
C5.where: quick-start.desktop.01, plugin-setup.desktop.01, notifications.desktop.01, changelog.desktop.01 (left column below ~900px); at-the-till.desktop.02 payment image

C6.worst_defect: On phone, long TypeScript lines in the quick-start code blocks wrap in the middle of an expression, so the code is hard to read or copy on a phone. Tables and till screenshots stack well otherwise.

C7.worst_defect: The search API's breadcrumbs are only ["VendurePOS"], with no section level. Every sitemap lastmod is 2026-11-17/18, which are build timestamps rather than content-change dates. All other technical checks are clean: Lighthouse 97-100, JSON-LD present, llms.txt present, 404 correct.

overall_worst.defect: Troubleshooting tells the reader "Ask the store owner to look at the sync log in this till's Settings", but the reader is the store owner. When register changes fail to send, the owner gets no steps: "till updates" isn't defined, and the page says nothing about what the sync log shows or how to fix or discard a refused update.
overall_worst.where: troubleshooting.desktop.01, "N till updates need attention" line
overall_worst.fix: Address the owner directly. Define till updates as register changes (opening float, pay in/out, closures). Say what the sync log in Settings shows for a refused update and the exact action (e.g. which button resends or discards it and when to do each). Use one name, "Send again" or "Retry", throughout.
